slices.focus: Using stronger spring numbers, Colleen refines the pipeline: cleaner packets, bus-trouble backup language, and principal-timed reminders.
slices.summary: With spring proof in hand, Colleen shifts from defending the program to refining its durability. She creates a plain rebooking reminder timed to principals' calendar cycles, adds make-up outreach language for when transportation falls through, and produces cleaner teacher-facing packets with less museum jargon. Her role feels more like stewardship of a durable pipeline than survival. She adds light tracking codes (reminder sent, rebooked, bus issue, switched to outreach).
open_loops: Reminder template needs final wording -- direct, not needy, respecting timing crunch

decisions: Colleen's education-manager role has shifted from proving year-round demand to building a more durable school-program pi
